purpose: Teach: イラストレーター/セレモニー/グラビア/コミケ/ゴシック/サイクリング/猪木/サンタクロース

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがイラストレーターのご友人をお持ちなのよ
lines.en: Sho — your father has an illustrator friend, you know.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact observation. Soft opening. Speaking to her son with the gentle certainty of someone sharing family news. Slight lift at the end, inviting him in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの会社のセレモニーに参加したよ
lines.en: Mom — I got to go to Dad's company ceremony!
lines.style: Bright, eager voice pitched high. Quick energy on the opening word. Bounces slightly on 'ceremony' — pride in being included. Seeking her approval and delight.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔のグラビア雑誌を整理されたわ
lines.en: Sho — your father organized his old magazines, apparently.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Quiet noticing. A small smile in the voice — tender recognition of what he's doing. Unfolds the information like she's been watching him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがコミケに連れて行って下さるって
lines.en: Mom — Dad's taking me to Comiket!
lines.style: Bright, almost breathless excitement. Words tumbling out fast. The thrill of being chosen, being taken somewhere special by his father. Pure childish joy, barely contained.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゴシック建築のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your father told me about Gothic architecture.
lines.style: Contemplative, slightly wondering. Speaking as though she's still turning over what he learned. Appreciative of the moment it must have been. Warm recognition of him learning something real.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとサイクリング楽しかったよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad and I had so much fun cycling together!
lines.style: Warm, genuine satisfaction in his voice. Quick, natural energy. The simple joy of shared time. An easy laugh underneath the words — remembering the feeling of it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが猪木の伝記をお買いになったわ
lines.en: Sho — your father bought a biography of Inoki.
lines.style: Noticing tone, slightly amused. A warm observation about what interests him. Speaking as if cataloging the small ways he's discovering the world. Gentle, affectionate regard.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがサンタクロースの絵本読んで下さったよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad read me a Santa picture book tonight.
lines.style: Soft, cozy voice trailing gently. The contentment of a bedtime moment. Sleepy satisfaction. Seeking her acknowledgment of this small, sweet thing that happened. Voice warm but winding down.
